thread:
sara (docs): Noticed the API reference for POST /v1/files/presign still shows the server returning a Location header with the upload URL, but our storage service changed to returning a JSON body with upload_url and expires_at (we switched to multi-region presigned URLs). A couple of customers filed issues when they followed the header example.

mike (eng-storage): yep, we rolled that change when we added the multi-region redirect logic. The previous behavior (Location header) was removed to avoid ambiguous redirects. We also added a small `region` field in the response body in case we need region-specific hints later.

sara (docs): current doc snippet: 
```http
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://files-us.redwood-inference.com/upload/abc123
```
But runtime now sends: 
```json
{
  "upload_url": "https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/us/abc123?sig=...",
  "expires_at": "2026-07-12T15:04:05Z",
  "region": "us-west-2"
}
```
Should we keep a short note about the 302 legacy or just replace the example?

mike (eng-storage): replace the example and add a short compatibility note. We removed the header because some proxies stripped it. Also confirm `expires_at` is RFC3339.

dan (sdk): SDKs currently parse Location header in the helper for simple uploads. I'll add parsing for `upload_url`/`expires_at` and handle both shapes for one release. I'll update Node+Python helper snippets in the docs.

emily (support): we've had two tickets where customers tried to read Location and got nothing. Can we add a troubleshooting snippet showing how to detect either form? e.g.: check for response.json().upload_url else response.headers.location.

sara (docs): good idea. Draft change list: 1) Replace header-based example with JSON body example (upload_url/expires_at/region). 2) Add compatibility note and small snippet showing how to handle legacy 302 Location header. 3) Update SDK helper snippets and link to SDK PRs. 4) Add a one-line note in "Files" migration guide and changelog.

ci-bot: docs-pr/1749332140-presign-response-shape-update queued (lint + snippet smoke).

dan (sdk): opened PRs and linked them in the docs PR comment. Quick JS example I'll add: 
```js
const body = await res.json();
const uploadUrl = body?.upload_url || res.headers.get('location');
if (!uploadUrl) throw new Error('no upload url returned');
```

mike (eng-storage): Confirming expires_at is RFC3339 and region is optional string. We will not reintroduce Location header. We'll emit a small deprecation warning in server logs for any request still relying on the old behavior for one release.

emily (support): thank you. I'll reply to the open tickets pointing to the draft PR.
